topics.title: Daily greetings, small talk and introductions
topics.sub: Chào hỏi, trò chuyện hàng ngày và làm quen

vocab.m: dạo này thế nào, mọi việc ổn chứ
vocab.d: a casual way to ask someone how they are
vocab.ex: Hey Linh, how's it going?
vocab.exm: Chào Linh, dạo này thế nào rồi?

vocab.d: said when meeting someone you haven't seen in a while
vocab.ex: Long time no see! You look great.
vocab.exm: Lâu rồi không gặp! Trông bạn tuyệt lắm.

vocab.d: a polite phrase said when introduced to someone
vocab.ex: Nice to meet you, I'm Sally.
vocab.exm: Rất vui được gặp bạn, tôi là Sally.

vocab.ex: Let's definitely keep in touch after the course.
vocab.exm: Sau khóa học chúng ta nhất định phải giữ liên lạc nhé.

vocab.m: hàn huyên, cập nhật tin tức
vocab.d: talk to someone to find out what has been happening in their life
vocab.ex: We should grab coffee and catch up soon.
vocab.exm: Hôm nào chúng ta đi cà phê hàn huyên sớm nhé.

vocab.m: bảo trọng, giữ gìn sức khỏe
vocab.d: a warm parting phrase wishing someone well
vocab.ex: Goodbye and take care on your trip!
vocab.exm: Tạm biệt và giữ gìn sức khỏe trong chuyến đi nhé!

vocab.d: a friendly phrase meaning have a good day
vocab.ex: Thanks for your help! Have a good one.
vocab.exm: Cảm ơn bạn đã giúp đỡ! Chúc một ngày tốt lành nhé.

vocab.m: cứ tự nhiên như ở nhà
vocab.d: tell a guest to feel comfortable and relaxed
vocab.ex: Come in, please make yourself at home.
vocab.exm: Mời vào, bạn cứ tự nhiên như ở nhà nhé.

vocab.d: used to introduce a new topic in conversation
vocab.ex: By the way, did you get my text message?
vocab.exm: Nhân tiện, bạn có nhận được tin nhắn của tôi không?

vocab.m: không sao đâu, đừng bận tâm
vocab.d: used to say that something is not a problem
vocab.ex: No worries, I can help you with that.
vocab.exm: Không sao đâu, tôi có thể giúp bạn việc đó.

vocab.m: rất hân hạnh, niềm vinh hạnh của tôi
vocab.d: a polite reply when someone thanks you
vocab.ex: You're welcome, it was my pleasure.
vocab.exm: Không có chi, đó là niềm vinh hạnh của tôi.

vocab.d: used to ask what interesting things have happened recently
vocab.ex: Hey Tom, what's new with you?
vocab.exm: Chào Tom, dạo này có gì mới không?

vocab.ex: I have to run now. See you around!
vocab.exm: Bây giờ tôi phải đi rồi. Hẹn gặp lại sau nhé!

vocab.d: it is your decision or choice
vocab.ex: We can eat pizza or noodles, it's up to you.
vocab.exm: Chúng ta có thể ăn pizza hoặc mì, tùy bạn đấy.

vocab.d: used to express agreement with a suggestion
vocab.ex: Let's meet at seven. — Sounds good!
vocab.exm: Hẹn nhau lúc bảy giờ nhé. — Nghe hay đấy!

quiz.q: You run into an old classmate on the street. What is the most friendly way to greet them?
o: Long time no see! How's it going?
quiz.why: 'Long time no see!' and 'How's it going?' are natural and warm greetings for someone you haven't seen for a while.

quiz.q: Someone thanks you warmly for your help. What is a polite and pleasant reply?
quiz.why: 'My pleasure' is a polite, graceful way to accept someone's thanks.

quiz.q: A friend suggests meeting for lunch tomorrow at noon. How do you agree enthusiastically?
quiz.why: 'Sounds good!' shows clear and friendly agreement.

quiz.q: A guest enters your apartment for the first time. What polite expression makes them feel comfortable?
o: Sit down and do not talk.
quiz.why: 'Make yourself at home' is the standard hospitable phrase for welcoming guests.

speak.title: Bumping into a friend on the street

lines.t: Hey Linh! Long time no see, how's it going?
lines.m: Chào Linh! Lâu rồi không gặp, dạo này thế nào rồi?

lines.t: I'm doing well! What's new with you?
lines.m: Mình vẫn khỏe! Cậu dạo này có gì mới không?

lines.t: Not much, just busy with work. We should catch up soon!
lines.m: Cũng không có gì nhiều, chỉ bận rộn với công việc. Hôm nào mình phải hàn huyên sớm nhé!

lines.t: Are you free this Saturday afternoon?
lines.m: Thứ Bảy tuần này cậu có rảnh vào buổi chiều không?

lines.t: Yes, I am. Do you want to grab coffee or go for a walk?
lines.m: Có chứ. Cậu muốn đi cà phê hay đi dạo?

lines.t: Either is fine with me, it's up to you!
lines.m: Cái nào cũng được, tùy cậu quyết định đấy!

coach.q: How has your week been so far?
coach.vi: Tuần này của bạn thế nào rồi?
coach.st: My week has been + adjective + because...
coach.sa: My week has been pretty busy with work, but everything is going smoothly.
ss: It has been quite productive so far.
I had a lot of meetings, but I feel good.
coach.sc: Small talk with an acquaintance or colleague.

coach.q: What do you usually say when greeting friends?
coach.vi: Bạn thường nói câu gì khi chào hỏi bạn bè?
coach.st: I usually say + phrase.
coach.sa: I usually say 'Hey, how's it going?' or 'Long time no see' if we haven't met for a while.
ss: It sounds friendly and natural.
It's an easy way to start a conversation.
coach.sc: Talking about daily conversational habits.

coach.q: How do you stay in touch with friends who live far away?
coach.vi: Làm thế nào bạn giữ liên lạc với bạn bè ở xa?
coach.st: I keep in touch by + method.
coach.sa: I keep in touch by texting on social media and video calling every month.
ss: We share photos and life updates often.
It helps us stay close even when living far apart.
coach.sc: Discussing friendships and communication.

fill.text:
Hey Mark,

[[Long time no see|Long time not see|Long time see]]! I hope you are doing well.

I am visiting your city next weekend. Would you be free to [[catch up|caught up|catching up]] over coffee?

Let me know what time works best for you. It's totally [[up to you|down to you|with you]].

[[Take care|Take safe|Take good]] and see you soon,
Sally
fill.trans:
Chào Mark,
Lâu rồi không gặp! Mình hy vọng cậu vẫn khỏe.
Cuối tuần tới mình có dịp ghé thăm thành phố của cậu. Cậu có rảnh để đi cà phê hàn huyên không?
Hãy báo cho mình biết giờ nào tiện nhất cho cậu nhé. Hoàn toàn tùy cậu đấy.
Bảo trọng và hẹn sớm gặp lại,
Sally

quiz.q: How do you say the number 15 in English?
quiz.why: 'Fifteen' là số 15, còn 'Fifty' là 50.

quiz.q: What number comes after nineteen (19)?
quiz.why: Sau 19 là 20 ('twenty').

quiz.q: How do you write 100 in words?
quiz.why: 'One hundred' là một trăm.

quiz.q: Which number represents 'zero'?
quiz.why: 'Zero' nghĩa là số không (0).

fill.text:
My weekdays always start the same way. My [[alarm clock|time clock|sound clock]] rings at 6:30 AM. I [[wake up|wake down|wake in]] immediately, brush my teeth, and [[get dressed|get clothe|get wear]] for work.

Living in a rented [[apartment|garden|street]] means I have to pay my [[rent|fare|fine]] and [[utility bill|school bill|train bill]] on time every month.

In the evening after my long commute, I help my roommate [[do the dishes|do the plates|do the food]] and clean the living room before we finally sit down on the sofa to relax.
fill.trans:
Các ngày trong tuần của tôi luôn bắt đầu theo cùng một cách. Đồng hồ báo thức của tôi reo lúc 6 giờ 30 sáng. Tôi thức dậy ngay, đánh răng và mặc quần áo đi làm.

Sống trong một căn hộ thuê đồng nghĩa với việc tôi phải thanh toán tiền nhà và hóa đơn điện nước đúng hạn mỗi tháng.

Vào buổi tối sau quãng đường đi làm dài, tôi giúp bạn cùng phòng rửa bát đĩa và dọn dẹp phòng khách trước khi chúng tôi ngồi xuống ghế sofa để thư giãn.

During my [[free time|busy time|hard time]], I love taking a break from city life. Whenever I feel stressed, I like to [[unwind|freeze|shout]] by going to the park.

Last Sunday, my friends and I had a delightful [[picnic|staycation|meeting]] by the lake. We brought homemade snacks, played an engaging [[board game|card board|chalk board]], and spent the entire afternoon [[hanging out|running out|falling out]] under the shade of tall pine trees. It was the perfect weekend recharge.
fill.trans:
Trong thời gian rảnh rỗi, tôi rất thích tạm rời xa sự ồn ào của phố thị. Mỗi khi thấy căng thẳng, tôi thích xả hơi bằng cách ra công viên.

Chủ nhật tuần trước, tôi và nhóm bạn đã có một buổi dã ngoại tuyệt vời bên hồ. Chúng tôi mang theo đồ ăn tự làm, chơi một trò chơi cờ bàn hấp dẫn và dành trọn buổi chiều tụ tập chuyện trò dưới bóng mát của những hàng thông cao vút. Đó thực sự là cách nạp lại năng lượng hoàn hảo cho ngày cuối tuần.

fill.text:
To improve my health, I made a resolution to [[work out|work off|work in]] four times a week. I signed up for a membership at the local [[fitness center|library|cinema]].

Every session begins with five minutes of gentle [[stretching|sleeping|driving]], followed by twenty minutes of cardio on the [[treadmill|table|chair]]. My [[personal trainer|landlord|doctor]] taught me proper posture to protect my joints and build muscle.

After only two months, my [[stamina|fever|ticket]] has increased noticeably, and I feel much more energetic throughout the workday.
fill.trans:
Để nâng cao sức khỏe, tôi đã đặt quyết tâm tập thể dục bốn lần một tuần. Tôi đăng ký thẻ hội viên tại phòng gym ở địa phương.

Mỗi buổi tập đều bắt đầu bằng năm phút giãn cơ nhẹ nhàng, sau đó là hai mươi phút tập cardio trên máy chạy bộ. Huấn luyện viên cá nhân đã hướng dẫn tôi tư thế chuẩn để bảo vệ xương khớp và phát triển cơ bắp.

Chỉ sau hai tháng, sức bền của tôi đã tăng lên trông thấy, và tôi cảm thấy tràn đầy năng lượng hơn hẳn trong suốt ngày làm việc.

fill.text:
Last Friday evening, my friend and I went to the [[movie theater|concert hall|sports field]] to see the latest superhero [[blockbuster|novel|song]].

The theater was packed, and the entire audience gave warm [[applause|tickets|screams]] when the hero appeared on screen.

The film's [[soundtrack|subtitle|ticket]] was majestic, and because the dialogue was spoken in English, having clear [[subtitles|advertisements|books]] helped us understand every clever joke. I enjoyed it so much that I might watch it again on a [[streaming service|music store|radio]] once it is released online.
fill.trans:
Tối thứ Sáu tuần trước, tôi và bạn đã đến rạp chiếu phim để xem bộ phim siêu anh hùng bom tấn mới nhất.

Rạp chật kín khán giả, và cả khán phòng đã vỗ tay tán thưởng nồng nhiệt khi người hùng xuất hiện trên màn ảnh.

Nhạc phim thật hùng tráng, và vì lời thoại bằng tiếng Anh nên việc có phụ đề rõ ràng đã giúp chúng tôi hiểu được từng câu đùa dí dỏm. Tôi thích đến mức có thể sẽ xem lại trên một dịch vụ phát trực tuyến khi phim được phát hành trên mạng.

fill.text:
For our summer [[vacation|work|meeting]], we decided to visit the coastal city of Da Nang. Weeks before our departure, I completed our [[flight reservation|ticket store|bus room]] and secured a lovely hotel room near My Khe Beach.

At the airport, the check-in agent handed us our [[boarding pass|post card|price tag]] and took our [[checked bag|trash bag|paper bag]].

Once we arrived and finished our hotel [[check in|check out|check up]], we joined a friendly [[tour guide|cashier|landlord]] for a day of [[sightseeing|shopping mall|laundry]]. From the marble mountains, we enjoyed a truly [[breathtaking view|bad view|cold view]] of the coastline.
fill.trans:
Cho kỳ nghỉ hè này, chúng tôi quyết định ghé thăm thành phố biển Đà Nẵng. Nhiều tuần trước ngày khởi hành, tôi đã hoàn tất việc đặt vé máy bay và đặt được một phòng khách sạn xinh xắn gần bãi biển Mỹ Khê.

Tại sân bay, nhân viên quầy làm thủ tục đã trao cho chúng tôi thẻ lên máy bay và nhận hành lý ký gửi.

Sau khi đến nơi và làm xong thủ tục nhận phòng khách sạn, chúng tôi cùng một hướng dẫn viên du lịch thân thiện đi tham quan ngắm cảnh trọn một ngày. Từ trên Ngũ Hành Sơn, chúng tôi đã chiêm ngưỡng một khung cảnh đẹp ngoạn mục của bờ biển.

lines.t: Good morning, doctor. I've had a sore throat and fever since yesterday.

lines.t: Let me examine your throat and take your temperature.

coach.q: What do you usually do when you catch a cold?

ph: rest at home and sleep more
take vitamin C and see a doctor
coach.sa: When I catch a cold, I usually drink warm ginger tea with honey, rest at home, and sleep early.
ss: Staying hydrated helps me recover faster.
If I have a high fever, I visit the clinic.

coach.q: How do you maintain a healthy lifestyle?

coach.q: Have you ever visited a hospital or clinic while traveling?

coach.st: Fortunately, I have never... / Yes, once I had to visit + clinic + because...

fill.trans:
Chiều Chủ nhật tuần trước, tôi thả bộ vào một hiệu sách thanh bình ở trung tâm thành phố. Tôi tìm kiếm cuốn sách bán chạy nhất vừa ra mắt của tác giả mình yêu thích. Các kệ sách tràn ngập hàng ngàn cuốn tiểu thuyết và tập thơ đầy cảm hứng.

Sau đó, tôi ghé qua bảo tàng thành phố để xem một cuộc triển lãm nghệ thuật hiện đại mới. Một bức tranh sơn dầu khổ lớn đã thu hút trọn ánh nhìn của tôi; ánh sáng và nét vẽ điêu luyện khiến nó trông như một kiệt tác thực thụ. Ghé thăm những không gian sáng tạo này luôn mang lại cho tôi nguồn cảm hứng mới mẻ dồi dào cho công việc của mình.

fill.trans:
Gần đây tôi đã tự thưởng cho mình một chiếc điện thoại thông minh mới với thời lượng pin siêu bền. Cùng với đó, tôi mua một cặp tai nghe không dây kiểu dáng đẹp để có thể nghe sách nói trên đường đi làm buổi sáng.

Trong thời gian rảnh rỗi, tôi rất thích trải nghiệm các công cụ trí tuệ nhân tạo mới nhất và chơi các trò chơi nhiều người cùng bạn bè trên máy chơi game chuyên dụng của mình. Chúng tôi có thể trò chuyện qua voice chat và chia sẻ những khoảnh khắc thú vị trong game.

Toàn bộ tiến trình game và ảnh chụp của tôi đều được sao lưu an toàn lên đám mây lưu trữ, vì vậy tôi không bao giờ phải lo lắng về việc mất dữ liệu.

quiz.q: You are opening a meeting with foreign partners. Which line sounds most natural and professional?
o: Thanks for joining. Let's start with a quick look at the agenda.
Okay, we start now. Listen to me.
quiz.why: Thank people for coming, then move to the agenda. That is the standard way to open.

quiz.q: You didn't catch the number your partner just said.
o: Sorry, could you repeat the last figure?
quiz.why: "Could you repeat..." is polite and says exactly what you need again.

quiz.q: Introduce your role.
o: I'm in charge of sales administration and key accounts.
My job is do the sales.
quiz.why: Use "be in charge of + noun".

quiz.q: You want someone to write the official record of the meeting.
o: Could you take the minutes today?
Could you speak the minutes today?
You write the meeting for me.
quiz.why: "Take the minutes" means to write the official record of a meeting.

quiz.q: The meeting is ending. How do you make sure everyone knows their tasks?
o: Let's recap the action items and who owns each one.
quiz.why: Recap the action items and the owners at the end of every meeting.

quiz.q: "Follow up" means…
o: contact someone again or check progress
quiz.why: To follow up is to check again on something you started earlier.

coach.sa: Please find attached the order confirmation with the quantity, price and estimated delivery date. Kindly confirm that everything is correct.
coach.sc: A new customer has just placed a first order and wants to be sure everything is understood correctly.

coach.q: What will you do to make up for the delay?
coach.vi: Bạn sẽ làm gì để bù đắp cho việc trễ hàng?
coach.st: To make up for it, we will + action.
coach.sa: To make up for the delay, we will give you a 5% discount on your next order and pay for the air freight, as a goodwill gesture.
coach.sc: The customer accepts your apology but asks what you can offer in return for the late delivery.

topics.title: Presenting products and handling price questions

vocab.d: something a product has or can do
vocab.ex: The key feature is its long battery life.
vocab.exm: Tính năng then chốt của sản phẩm là thời lượng pin dài.

vocab.ex: The main benefit for you is lower maintenance cost.
vocab.exm: Lợi ích chính dành cho anh/chị là chi phí bảo trì thấp hơn.

vocab.d: as good as or better than others in price
vocab.ex: Our price is very competitive for this quality.
vocab.exm: Giá của chúng tôi rất cạnh tranh so với chất lượng này.

vocab.d: an amount taken off the normal price
vocab.ex: We can offer a 5% discount for orders over 1,000 units.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi có thể chiết khấu 5% cho đơn hàng trên 1.000 sản phẩm.

vocab.d: the smallest amount a customer can order
vocab.ex: Our MOQ is 500 pieces.
vocab.exm: Số lượng đặt tối thiểu (MOQ) của chúng tôi là 500 chiếc.

vocab.d: a promise to repair or replace a product
vocab.ex: It comes with a two-year warranty.
vocab.exm: Sản phẩm được bảo hành hai năm.

vocab.ex: Customers see it as good value for money.
vocab.exm: Khách hàng đánh giá sản phẩm này rất đáng đồng tiền.

vocab.ex: Let me explain what justifies the price.
vocab.exm: Để tôi giải thích điều gì chứng minh mức giá này là hợp lý.

vocab.m: tự sản xuất hay mua ngoài
vocab.d: the decision to produce something yourself or buy it from a supplier
vocab.ex: This is a make or buy decision for the management team.
vocab.exm: Đây là quyết định tự sản xuất hay mua ngoài của ban quản lý.

vocab.d: pay another company to do work or make parts for you
vocab.ex: We outsource packaging to a local partner.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi thuê ngoài khâu đóng gói cho một đối tác địa phương.

vocab.d: done inside the company, not by an outside supplier
vocab.ex: We do all quality checks in-house.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi tự thực hiện toàn bộ việc kiểm tra chất lượng trong nội bộ.

vocab.m: dùng nguồn ở nước lân cận
vocab.d: use suppliers in a nearby country
vocab.ex: Nearshore suppliers can cut transit time by weeks.
vocab.exm: Các nhà cung cấp dùng nguồn ở nước lân cận có thể rút ngắn thời gian vận chuyển hàng tuần.

vocab.d: use suppliers in a distant country (also called offshore)
vocab.ex: Farshore suppliers offer low prices but longer lead times.
vocab.exm: Các nhà cung cấp dùng nguồn ở nước xa có giá thấp nhưng thời gian giao hàng lâu hơn.

vocab.d: the full cost of buying, including freight, duty, inspection and delays, not just the unit price
vocab.ex: The total cost is much higher than the quote suggests.
vocab.exm: Tổng chi phí cao hơn nhiều so với báo giá.

vocab.d: the cost of a product once it reaches your warehouse, including freight, insurance and duty
vocab.ex: Please calculate the landed cost per unit.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng tính giá về tới kho trên mỗi đơn vị.

vocab.d: an extra cost that is easy to miss when you compare offers
vocab.ex: Long transit times create a hidden cost in extra stock.
vocab.exm: Thời gian vận chuyển dài tạo ra chi phí ẩn do phải dự trữ thêm hàng.

vocab.d: a tax that a government puts on imported goods
vocab.ex: The new tariff adds ten percent to the price.
vocab.exm: Thuế quan mới làm giá tăng thêm mười phần trăm.

vocab.d: the tax paid on goods when they enter a country
vocab.ex: Who pays the import duty under this term?
vocab.exm: Ai là người trả thuế nhập khẩu theo điều kiện này?

vocab.d: a key supplier you build a close, long-term partnership with
vocab.ex: They are a strategic supplier for our main product line.
vocab.exm: Họ là nhà cung cấp chiến lược cho dòng sản phẩm chính của chúng tôi.

vocab.d: a lower cost per unit when you produce or buy in larger quantities
vocab.ex: Bigger orders give us economies of scale.
vocab.exm: Đơn hàng lớn hơn mang lại cho chúng tôi lợi thế nhờ quy mô.

quiz.q: The customer says: "Your price is higher than your competitor's." How do you answer?
o: I understand. Let me show you what's included in our price.
quiz.why: Agree with the concern, then move to value. Don't argue and don't drop the price at once.

quiz.q: Tell the customer the main benefit.
o: The main benefit for you is lower maintenance cost.
The main benefit for you are lower maintain cost.
quiz.why: Use "benefit is + noun"; maintenance is a noun.

quiz.q: Talk about the minimum order.
o: Our minimum order quantity is 500 pieces.
Our minimum order is 500 piece minimum.
You must order minimum 500 pieces quantity.
quiz.why: Use the fixed phrase minimum order quantity (MOQ).

quiz.q: The customer asks what makes your product different.
o: Our main advantage is durability, which gives you better value for money.
Our product is just different, that's all.
Ask our competitors, they will tell you.
quiz.why: Name one clear benefit and link it to the customer's interest.

quiz.q: The customer thinks the cheapest offer is best. What do you say?
o: The lowest price is not always the lowest total cost, because of shipping and duty.
Cost is not important for this.
quiz.why: Explain total cost: transport, duty and other costs matter.

quiz.q: "In-house" means…
quiz.why: In-house work is done by your own team, not by an outside company.

speak.title: Present a product in one minute

lines.t: Let me introduce our best-selling model.
Its key feature is a two-year warranty.
The main benefit for you is lower maintenance cost.

speak.title: Reply when a customer says the price is too high

lines.t: I understand your concern about the price.
Let me explain what's included.
For orders over 1,000 units, we can offer a 5% discount.

coach.q: What makes this new product special?
coach.vi: Điều gì làm cho sản phẩm mới này đặc biệt?
coach.st: This product offers + key feature / key benefit.
coach.sa: This product offers unique design features, a handcrafted finish, and strong commercial appeal. That is what makes it special in the market.
ss: We have recently launched a new furniture and home decor collection designed for customers who want something more distinctive in their market.
This product offers unique design features, a handcrafted finish, and a look that works well in modern living spaces.
It also provides strong commercial value because the materials and finishing are suitable for repeated retail orders.
This collection stands out because it combines natural textures, practical use, and strong visual appeal.
coach.sc: The customer is a large distributor looking for distinctive products for their market. You need to introduce the new product line in a strong and memorable way.

coach.q: Who is the target customer for this?
coach.vi: Khách hàng mục tiêu cho sản phẩm này là ai?
coach.st: The target customer is + customer group.
coach.sa: The target customer is young professionals, health-conscious families, and urban trendsetters.
ss: The target customer is young professionals who are looking for stylish furniture and home accessories for modern apartments.
This product is also suitable for families who care about design, durability, and everyday practicality.
It can also appeal to lifestyle stores and boutique distributors looking for distinctive pottery and decor pieces.
coach.sc: The customer is a large distributor looking for distinctive products for their market. You need to introduce the new product line in a strong and memorable way.

coach.q: How do you support your distributors?
coach.vi: Bạn hỗ trợ các nhà phân phối của mình như thế nào?
coach.st: We provide + support method.
coach.sa: We provide marketing materials, training sessions, and after-sales service to support our distributors.
ss: We provide product catalogs, photos, and display suggestions to help our distributors promote the collection effectively.
We also provide training sessions so their sales team can understand the materials, finishes, and key selling points clearly.
In addition, we offer after-sales support and order follow-up to help them handle customer feedback after launch.
coach.sc: The customer is a large distributor looking for distinctive products for their market. You need to introduce the new product line in a strong and memorable way.

coach.q: What is the production lead time?
coach.vi: Thời gian sản xuất là bao lâu?
coach.st: The lead time is + time frame / processing type.
coach.sa: The lead time is usually four weeks for standard processing, but customized scheduling may take longer depending on the design and order volume.
ss: The lead time is usually four weeks for standard furniture items.
For pottery or customized pieces, the lead time may be slightly longer because of sampling, glaze approval, and finishing.
Our standard processing works well for repeat orders, while customized scheduling is available for special collections or project-based orders.
If you share the quantity and specifications, I can confirm a more accurate lead time for you.
coach.sc: The customer is a large distributor looking for distinctive products for their market. You need to introduce the new product line in a strong and memorable way.

coach.q: Why should we choose this product?
coach.vi: Tại sao chúng tôi nên chọn sản phẩm này?
coach.st: You should choose this for + business benefit / product value.
coach.sa: You should choose this for market differentiation, high profit margins, and stronger customer loyalty.
ss: You should choose this for market differentiation because the design is distinctive and not easy to replace with mass-market items.
This collection can also support high profit margins, especially for lifestyle stores selling furniture, home decor, or pottery with a handcrafted story.
Another reason is customer loyalty, because well-designed and consistent products often encourage repeat purchases.
If your market is looking for products with both visual appeal and commercial potential, this could be a strong choice.
coach.sc: The customer is a large distributor looking for distinctive products for their market. You need to introduce the new product line in a strong and memorable way.

coach.q: Why is your price higher than others?
coach.vi: Tại sao giá của bạn cao hơn bên khác?
coach.st: The reason is + price factor.
coach.sa: The reason is premium materials, advanced technology, and strict quality control.
ss: The reason is that we use premium materials and pay close attention to finishing quality.
Another reason is that our production process includes advanced technology where needed and strong coordination between design, sampling, and mass production.
We also apply strict quality control, which helps reduce defects and maintain consistency across export orders.
coach.sc: The customer believes your price is higher than the competitors and wants an explanation for the difference.

coach.q: What value do we get for this price?
coach.vi: Với mức giá này chúng tôi nhận được giá trị gì?
coach.st: You receive + value element.
coach.sa: You receive exclusive features, dedicated support, and in some cases extended warranty for this price.
ss: For this price, you receive exclusive features that are not easy to find in standard mass-market products.
You also receive dedicated support from our team during development, production, and order follow-up.
Depending on the product category and project terms, extended warranty or after-sales support may also be included.
coach.sc: The customer believes your price is higher than the competitors and wants an explanation for the difference.

coach.q: Can you offer a lower price?
coach.vi: Bạn có thể đưa giá thấp hơn không?
coach.st: I can consider + condition / pricing option.
coach.sa: I can consider a lower price for bulk orders, long-term partnership opportunities, or special promotions.
ss: I can consider a better price for bulk orders, depending on the final quantity and specifications.
We are also open to discussing more competitive pricing for a long-term partnership.
In some cases, we may be able to support special promotions for selected collections or order programs.
coach.sc: The customer believes your price is higher than the competitors and wants an explanation for the difference.

coach.q: How is your product different?
coach.vi: Sản phẩm của bạn khác biệt như thế nào?
coach.st: Our product offers + differentiating feature.
coach.sa: Our product offers unique design, higher durability, and in some cases patented solutions.
ss: Our product offers a unique design that is more distinctive than standard market alternatives.
In some cases, it may also include a patented solution or a specialized technical feature, depending on the product line.
Another key difference is higher durability, which is especially important for customers looking for long-term product performance.
coach.sc: The customer believes your price is higher than the competitors and wants an explanation for the difference.

coach.q: What is included in the price?
coach.vi: Mức giá này bao gồm những gì?
coach.sa: The price includes the product, standard packing, and the agreed specifications, with additional services depending on the quotation terms.
ss: The price usually includes the product itself, standard packing, and the agreed finishing specifications.
Depending on the quotation term, it may also include sampling support, quality inspection, or export coordination.
If you need, I can break the quotation down for you so you can see exactly what is included.
coach.sc: The customer believes your price is higher than the competitors and wants an explanation for the difference.

coach.q: What is the expected lifespan of this product?
coach.vi: Tuổi thọ dự kiến của sản phẩm này là bao lâu?
coach.st: The expected lifespan is + duration / durability description.
coach.sa: The expected lifespan is around ten years, with extended service life and reliable operation under normal conditions.
ss: The expected lifespan is around ten years under normal usage conditions, depending on the environment and maintenance level.
The product is designed for extended service life and stable day-to-day performance.
Our focus is not only on appearance, but also on reliable operation over time.
coach.sc: The customer is a technical company that cares strongly about product durability. You need to give a convincing explanation of product lifespan and reliability.

coach.q: How was it tested for durability?
coach.vi: Sản phẩm đã được kiểm tra độ bền như thế nào?
coach.st: We tested it with + testing method.
coach.sa: We tested it with stress simulations, repeated load cycles, and impact analysis.
ss: We tested it with stress simulations to evaluate how the product performs under demanding conditions.
We also used repeated load cycles to measure stability and long-term structural performance.
In addition, impact analysis helped us understand how the product responds to pressure and sudden force.
coach.sc: The customer is a technical company that cares strongly about product durability. You need to give a convincing explanation of product lifespan and reliability.

coach.q: What materials contribute to its strength?
coach.vi: Những vật liệu nào góp phần tạo nên độ bền của sản phẩm?
coach.st: The main materials are + material list.
coach.sa: The main materials are reinforced steel, composite polymers, and high-grade aluminum.
ss: The main materials are reinforced steel, composite polymers, and high-grade aluminum, depending on the product type.
These materials were selected because they offer a strong balance between strength, weight, and durability.
We also pay attention to finishing and assembly, because durability depends on both materials and production quality.
coach.sc: The customer is a technical company that cares strongly about product durability. You need to give a convincing explanation of product lifespan and reliability.

coach.q: What kind of warranty covers it?
coach.vi: Sản phẩm được bảo hành như thế nào?
coach.st: The warranty includes + support item.
coach.sa: The warranty includes replacement parts, technical support, and repair service when applicable.
ss: The warranty includes replacement parts for confirmed production-related issues within the covered period.
We also provide technical support to help customers identify the issue and choose the best solution.
If necessary, repair service can also be arranged depending on the product type and market location.
coach.sc: The customer is a technical company that cares strongly about product durability. You need to give a convincing explanation of product lifespan and reliability.

coach.q: How does it perform in harsh conditions?
coach.vi: Sản phẩm hoạt động như thế nào trong điều kiện khắc nghiệt?
coach.st: It performs well in + harsh environment type.
coach.sa: It performs well in extreme temperatures, high humidity, and other demanding environments when the right materials and finishing are applied.
ss: It performs well in extreme temperatures when used within the tested operating range.
The product is also designed to maintain stable performance in high-humidity environments with proper material treatment and finishing.
For corrosive environments, we can recommend suitable coatings, materials, or protective specifications based on the actual use case.
coach.sc: The customer is a technical company that cares strongly about product durability. You need to give a convincing explanation of product lifespan and reliability.

fill.text:
Subject: Re: Price for model X200

Dear Ms. Chen,

Thank you for your feedback on our price. I understand your [[concern|concerned|concerning]].

Our price includes a two-year [[warranty|warrant|warranted]] and free technical support. For orders [[over|above of|more]] 1,000 units, we can offer a 5% discount.

We believe the X200 is good value [[for|of|to]] money.

Best regards,
Sally

topics.title: Emails to suppliers and factories: orders, specifications, quality problems

vocab.d: an official document in which a buyer orders goods
vocab.ex: Please confirm receipt of purchase order PO-2048.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng xác nhận đã nhận đơn đặt hàng PO-2048.

vocab.d: the number of units in an order
vocab.ex: The order quantity is 2,000 units.
vocab.exm: Số lượng đặt hàng là 2.000 sản phẩm.

vocab.d: the cost of making or buying one item
vocab.ex: Can you break down the unit cost for this item?
vocab.exm: Anh/chị có thể bóc tách giá thành một đơn vị của mặt hàng này không?

vocab.d: the basic material used to make a product
vocab.ex: The price of raw material went up by eight percent.
vocab.exm: Giá nguyên liệu thô đã tăng tám phần trăm.

vocab.d: the plan that shows when each step of production happens
vocab.ex: Could you send us the production schedule for this order?
vocab.exm: Anh/chị có thể gửi cho chúng tôi kế hoạch sản xuất cho đơn hàng này không?

vocab.d: a sample made before mass production to check quality
vocab.ex: We need to approve the pre-production sample first.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi cần duyệt mẫu trước sản xuất trước.

vocab.d: a document that proves the quality of the material
vocab.ex: Please attach the material certificate to the shipment.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng đính kèm chứng chỉ vật liệu cùng lô hàng.

vocab.d: the share of products that have a fault
vocab.ex: The defect rate in the last batch was 4 percent.
vocab.exm: Tỷ lệ lỗi của lô hàng trước là 4 phần trăm.

vocab.m: sự không phù hợp (so với yêu cầu)
vocab.d: a product or process that does not meet the requirement
vocab.ex: We found a non-conformance in the packaging.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi phát hiện một sự không phù hợp so với yêu cầu ở phần đóng gói.

vocab.d: having a fault and not working as it should
vocab.ex: Twenty cartons contained defective units.
vocab.exm: Hai mươi thùng có chứa sản phẩm bị lỗi.

vocab.d: the level of quality that a product must reach
vocab.ex: The goods do not meet our quality standard.
vocab.exm: Hàng hóa không đạt tiêu chuẩn chất lượng của chúng tôi.

vocab.d: a document with the results of a quality check
vocab.ex: The inspection report shows two major defects.
vocab.exm: Báo cáo kiểm hàng cho thấy hai lỗi nghiêm trọng.

vocab.d: one period of making a set number of products
vocab.ex: The next production run starts on Monday.
vocab.exm: Đợt sản xuất tiếp theo bắt đầu vào thứ Hai.

vocab.m: làm lại, sửa lại hàng lỗi
vocab.d: repair or redo a product so that it meets the requirement
vocab.ex: We expect you to rework the faulty units at your cost.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi mong anh/chị làm lại các sản phẩm lỗi bằng chi phí của phía anh/chị.

vocab.d: a formal request to change the order or the specification
vocab.ex: We would like to submit a change request for the logo position.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi muốn gửi yêu cầu thay đổi về vị trí logo.

vocab.d: the date when the goods are ready to be collected
vocab.ex: What is the ready date for the second batch?
vocab.exm: Ngày hàng sẵn sàng của lô thứ hai là khi nào?

vocab.d: a label on the outside of a carton
vocab.ex: Each carton label must show the PO number.
vocab.exm: Mỗi nhãn thùng hàng phải ghi số PO.

vocab.d: confirm that you have received something
vocab.ex: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng xác nhận đã nhận email này.

vocab.d: agree officially that a sample is good enough
vocab.ex: We will approve the sample after the test.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi sẽ duyệt mẫu sau khi thử nghiệm.

vocab.ex: We would appreciate a prompt reply, as the deadline is tight.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi rất mong nhận được phản hồi nhanh vì thời hạn khá gấp.

quiz.q: You are sending a purchase order to a factory. Which sentence works best?
o: Please find attached purchase order PO-2048. Kindly acknowledge receipt and confirm the ready date.
Here is order. You make and send soon.
I want to buy, please do it fast.
quiz.why: Name the document, then say exactly what you need back: acknowledgement and a date.

quiz.q: The last batch had a high defect rate. How do you ask for action?
o: Please investigate the root cause and send us your corrective action plan by Friday.
Fix the problem or we will stop everything.
quiz.why: Ask for a cause, a plan and a deadline. It is firm and still professional.

quiz.q: A supplier gave a new price by phone. What should you write?
o: Thank you for the call. Could you please confirm the new price in writing?
OK, I note it in my head.
quiz.why: Prices and terms should always be confirmed in writing so both sides have a record.

quiz.q: "Pre-production sample" means…
o: a sample made to approve quality before mass production
a sample made after the goods ship
quiz.why: Approve the sample before the factory starts mass production.

quiz.q: You want to know when the factory will be ready.
o: Could you confirm the ready date for the second batch?
The batch is ready or no?
quiz.why: Ask for a specific date, and name the batch.

quiz.q: The factory proposes a later date, but your customer's deadline is fixed.
o: We can't accept a later date, as our customer's deadline is fixed. Could you expedite?
Late is not okay, we will leave you.
Maybe later is fine, you decide.
quiz.why: Explain the reason and ask for a solution.

speak.title: Call a factory about a quality problem

lines.t: Hello, this is Sally. I'm calling about the last batch.
Our inspector found two major defects in the packaging.
Could you check the root cause and send us a corrective action plan by Friday?

speak.title: Ask a supplier to confirm a new order

lines.t: We would like to place a new order for 2,000 units.
Could you confirm the ready date and the payment terms?
Please send us the pro forma invoice in writing.

coach.q: Why are you changing the order?
coach.vi: Vì sao bạn thay đổi đơn hàng?
coach.st: We would like to submit a change request because + reason.
coach.sa: We would like to submit a change request because our customer asked for a new packaging design and a different logo position.
coach.sc: A supplier is surprised that you want to change an order that is already in production.

coach.q: Can you explain the quality problem?
coach.vi: Bạn có thể giải thích vấn đề chất lượng không?
coach.st: We found + problem + in + batch / product.
coach.sa: We found two major defects in this batch, as shown in the inspection report. The packaging does not meet the specification.
coach.sc: Your factory contact asks you to explain exactly what is wrong with the last delivery.

coach.q: When can you send the next batch?
coach.vi: Khi nào bạn có thể gửi lô tiếp theo?
coach.st: The ready date is + date, if + condition.
coach.sa: The ready date is 20 January, if we approve the pre-production sample and pay the deposit by next week.
coach.sc: You are planning the schedule with a supplier and need a clear date and the condition for it.

I call you now and you answer.

We want to make a lot of money from you.
We only work for a short time.

vocab.d: a buyer's official document to order goods

vocab.m: giao hàng lên tàu tại cảng đi

When the goods leave the factory
When the buyer pays the invoice

coach.q: How can we customize the product?
coach.vi: Chúng tôi có thể tùy chỉnh sản phẩm như thế nào?
coach.st: We can customize + product element.
coach.sa: We can customize the product in terms of size, material, color, finish, and design details.
ss: We can customize the product based on your preferred size, material, color, glaze, and finishing details.
For furniture or pottery items, we can also adjust the shape, surface effect, or packaging style depending on your market needs.
If you have a reference design or mood board, we can develop the sample based on that direction.
coach.sc: The customer wants to order products based on their own design. You need to explain your process and customization capability clearly.

coach.q: What is the process for custom orders?
coach.vi: Quy trình cho đơn hàng tùy chỉnh là gì?
coach.st: The process starts with + first step.
coach.sa: The process starts with your brief, then sample development, approval, and finally bulk production.
ss: The process starts with your design brief or reference sample.
After that, we confirm the specifications and prepare a sample for your review and approval.
Once the sample is approved, we move to bulk production according to the agreed timeline and requirements.
coach.sc: The customer wants to order products based on their own design. You need to explain your process and customization capability clearly.

coach.q: Is there a minimum order for customization?
coach.vi: Có số lượng tối thiểu cho đơn hàng tùy chỉnh không?
coach.st: The minimum order depends on + factor.
coach.sa: The minimum order depends on the product type and the complexity of the customization.
ss: The minimum order depends on the product type, design complexity, and material requirements.
For some customized items, we may be flexible if the design can fit into our existing production process.
For more specialized developments, a higher minimum order quantity may be needed to make the project workable.
coach.sc: The customer wants to order products based on their own design. You need to explain your process and customization capability clearly.

coach.q: How long does it take to get a sample?

ss: It usually takes around two to four weeks to prepare a sample, depending on the design and materials.
If the product requires special molds, glazes, or construction adjustments, the sample lead time may be slightly longer.
Once we receive all the confirmed details, we can give you a more accurate sample timeline.
coach.sc: The customer wants to order products based on their own design. You need to explain your process and customization capability clearly.

coach.q: What are the extra costs involved?
coach.vi: Có những chi phí phát sinh nào?

In some cases, there may also be extra costs for special finishes, additional testing, or design revisions.
We always try to explain these costs clearly before moving forward, so there are no surprises later.
coach.sc: The customer wants to order products based on their own design. You need to explain your process and customization capability clearly.

quiz.q: A customer says the goods arrived damaged. Which opening line is best?
o: We're sorry to hear that some boxes arrived damaged.
quiz.why: Show understanding first, deal with responsibility later.

quiz.q: Give the departure and arrival dates.
o: ETD is 5 November and ETA is 12 November.
ETA is 5 November leave and ETD 12 arrive.
The ship go 5 and come 12 November.
quiz.why: ETD is when the ship leaves, ETA is when it arrives.

quiz.q: Ask the customer for evidence to handle the claim.
o: Could you send us photos of the damaged items?
Give us photo or we do nothing.
quiz.why: A polite request that says exactly what you need.

quiz.q: Which document lists what is inside each carton?
quiz.why: The packing list shows the contents of every carton.

quiz.q: A customer reports a shortage. What do you ask for first?
o: Could you send us the packing list and photos of the cartons you received?
Please count again, you are wrong.
Tell us what you want us to do.
quiz.why: Ask for facts and photos before you decide on a solution.

quiz.q: "Root cause" means…
o: the main reason for a problem
the first part of a plant
quiz.why: Finding the root cause stops the same problem from happening again.

topics.title: Biomass pellets 1: the product, quality and specifications

vocab.d: plant material, such as wood, that is used as fuel

vocab.d: a small compressed cylinder of sawdust used as fuel
vocab.ex: Our wood pellets are made from clean sawdust.
vocab.exm: Viên nén gỗ của chúng tôi được làm từ mùn cưa sạch.

vocab.d: very small pieces of wood made when wood is cut
vocab.ex: The factory uses sawdust from local sawmills.
vocab.exm: Nhà máy sử dụng mùn cưa từ các xưởng cưa địa phương.

vocab.d: wood from trees such as pine
vocab.ex: Softwood pellets burn very cleanly.
vocab.exm: Viên nén gỗ mềm cháy rất sạch.

vocab.d: wood from trees such as oak or acacia
vocab.ex: These pellets are made from hardwood.
vocab.exm: Những viên nén này được làm từ gỗ cứng.

vocab.d: press something to make it smaller and denser
vocab.ex: The machine compresses the sawdust into pellets.
vocab.exm: Máy nén mùn cưa thành viên nén.

vocab.d: the amount of heat that a fuel gives when it burns
vocab.ex: The net calorific value is at least 16.5 MJ per kilogram.
vocab.exm: Nhiệt trị thực tối thiểu là 16,5 MJ mỗi kilôgam.

vocab.d: the percentage of water in a material

vocab.d: the percentage of material left after burning

vocab.d: the weight of a material in a given volume

vocab.exm: Khối lượng riêng xô trên 600 kilôgam mỗi mét khối.

vocab.d: how well a pellet resists breaking into dust
vocab.ex: The mechanical durability is 98 percent.
vocab.exm: Độ bền cơ học là 98 phần trăm.

vocab.d: very small pieces and dust in a pellet shipment
vocab.ex: The fines must be less than 1 percent.
vocab.exm: Bụi và mảnh vụn phải dưới 1 phần trăm.

vocab.d: the width of a round object
vocab.ex: The diameter of the pellets is 6 millimetres.
vocab.exm: Đường kính của viên nén là 6 mm.

vocab.d: a substance added to a product for a special purpose
vocab.ex: Our pellets contain no chemical additive.
vocab.exm: Viên nén của chúng tôi không chứa phụ gia hóa học.

vocab.d: the percentage of sulphur in a fuel
vocab.ex: The sulphur content is very low.
vocab.exm: Hàm lượng lưu huỳnh rất thấp.

vocab.d: a test carried out in a laboratory
vocab.ex: We can send the lab analysis of the last batch.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi có thể gửi phân tích phòng thí nghiệm của lô hàng gần nhất.

vocab.d: officially approved by an independent body

vocab.d: not harming the environment for the future

vocab.d: a machine that burns fuel to heat water

vocab.d: a measurable property used to judge quality

quiz.q: A buyer asks about the quality of the pellets. Which answer is best?
o: The moisture content is below 8 percent, and the ash content is 0.6 percent.
The quality is good, very good.
Our pellets are the best in the world.
quiz.why: Give measured values. Buyers compare moisture, ash and heat value.

quiz.q: You need to prove the pellets meet the standard.
o: We can send the lab analysis and the ENplus certificate.
Please trust us, we are a good company.
quiz.why: Documents such as a lab analysis and a certificate are the normal proof.

quiz.q: The buyer asks why fines are important.
o: Too many fines mean more dust, and they can cause problems in the boiler.
Fines do not matter at all.
quiz.why: Explain the effect: dust, waste and boiler problems.

quiz.q: "Calorific value" tells you…
o: how much heat the fuel gives when it burns
how long the fuel can be stored
quiz.why: Buyers compare pellets by calorific value.

quiz.q: Which value should be low in good pellets?
quiz.why: High ash content leaves more waste in the boiler.

quiz.q: You want the size of the pellets.
o: What are the diameter and the length of your pellets?
Are your pellets big or small?
quiz.why: Ask for exact dimensions with a clear question.

coach.q: Why should we choose your pellets?

coach.st: You should choose us because + reasons.

coach.sc: The buyer is comparing three suppliers and asks you for your main advantages.

topics.title: Buying through a distributor: quotes, terms and written confirmation

vocab.d: a company officially approved by a brand to sell and support its products in a market
vocab.ex: Le Hoang is the authorized distributor for Unitree in Vietnam.
vocab.exm: Le Hoang là nhà phân phối chính thức của Unitree tại Việt Nam.

vocab.d: a document showing the standard prices of a company's products
vocab.ex: Could you send us your latest price list for the A2 series?
vocab.exm: Anh/chị có thể gửi cho chúng tôi bảng giá mới nhất của dòng A2 không?

vocab.m: báo giá chi tiết từng hạng mục
vocab.d: a quotation that lists the price of each item separately
vocab.ex: Please send an itemized quotation so we can see the cost of each accessory.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng gửi báo giá chi tiết từng hạng mục để chúng tôi xem được chi phí của từng phụ kiện.

vocab.d: with value added tax already included in the price
vocab.ex: Is this price inclusive of VAT?
vocab.exm: Giá này đã bao gồm VAT chưa?

vocab.d: without tax included in the price
vocab.ex: All prices are exclusive of tax and shipping.
vocab.exm: Tất cả giá đều chưa gồm thuế và phí vận chuyển.

vocab.d: an official invoice showing the VAT charged, needed for accounting
vocab.ex: We will need a VAT invoice issued to our company name.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi cần hoá đơn VAT xuất đúng tên công ty của chúng tôi.

vocab.d: the particular set of parts and options chosen for a product
vocab.ex: We have not decided on the final configuration yet.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi vẫn chưa quyết định cấu hình cuối cùng.

vocab.d: an extra item that can be added to a main product
vocab.ex: The charging dock is sold as an optional accessory.
vocab.exm: Trạm sạc được bán như một phụ kiện tùy chọn.

vocab.d: a set of products or services sold together for one price
vocab.ex: Is the inspection software included in the bundle?
vocab.exm: Phần mềm kiểm tra có nằm trong gói sản phẩm không?

vocab.d: the planned dates on which goods will be delivered
vocab.ex: Please confirm the delivery schedule once we place the order.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng xác nhận lịch giao hàng sau khi chúng tôi đặt hàng.

vocab.d: on paper or by email, not only spoken
vocab.ex: Could you confirm the warranty terms in writing?
vocab.exm: Anh/chị có thể xác nhận điều khoản bảo hành bằng văn bản không?

vocab.d: the person who has the authority to make the final decision

vocab.exm: Giám đốc của chúng tôi là người ra quyết định cuối cùng cho khoản mua này.

vocab.d: a question asked after an answer, to get more detail
vocab.ex: I have a few follow-up questions about the battery.
vocab.exm: Tôi có vài câu hỏi bổ sung về pin.

vocab.m: còn tồn đọng, chưa giải quyết
vocab.d: not yet answered, paid or done

vocab.d: contact someone again to get something they have not sent yet

vocab.exm: Tôi sẽ đôn đốc báo giá nếu họ không phản hồi trước thứ Sáu.

vocab.d: waiting for a decision or action

vocab.exm: Việc mua hàng đang chờ giám đốc của chúng tôi phê duyệt.

vocab.d: official permission to spend a certain amount of money
vocab.ex: We need budget approval before we can confirm the order.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi cần được duyệt ngân sách trước khi có thể xác nhận đơn hàng.

vocab.d: a contract that sets out the terms of a purchase

vocab.d: help given to customers after they have bought a product

vocab.exm: Giá này có bao gồm hỗ trợ hậu mãi tại Úc không?

vocab.d: connecting a product with other hardware or software so they work together
vocab.ex: The distributor also offers system integration for custom software.

quiz.q: The distributor's quote does not say whether VAT is included. Which sentence asks most clearly?
o: Could you confirm whether the quoted price is inclusive of VAT?
Your price has VAT or not, tell me.
quiz.why: Use "confirm whether" with a full statement; "inclusive of VAT" is the standard phrase.

quiz.q: You have waited a week for answers to 11 questions. What is the best follow-up?
o: I'm just following up on the questions we sent last week. Could you let us know when we can expect a reply?
Why have you not answered yet?
quiz.why: Refer to the earlier email, stay polite and ask for a timeline.

quiz.q: Your director has not approved the purchase yet. How do you tell the supplier?
o: The order is still pending budget approval, so we can't confirm it yet.
The order is approve later maybe.
quiz.why: "Pending + noun" explains a delay without sounding negative.

quiz.q: Ask the distributor whether the price includes the charging dock and software.
o: Does the quoted price include the charging dock and the inspection software?
Price has dock and software or not?
quiz.why: Be specific about each item that might be missing from the quote.

quiz.q: What does "authorized distributor" mean?
o: a company officially approved by the brand to sell its products
a company that makes the products
a shop that sells used goods
quiz.why: An authorized distributor can offer warranty and support.

quiz.q: You need the delivery date to be certain.
o: Could you confirm the delivery schedule in writing?
Tell me the day, I will remember.
quiz.why: Ask for key dates in writing so that both sides have a record.

vocab.d: able to be replaced while the machine is still running
vocab.ex: The A2 has hot-swappable batteries, so it can work in shifts.
vocab.exm: A2 có pin thay nóng nên có thể làm việc theo ca.

vocab.d: a code that shows how well a device is protected against dust and water
vocab.ex: We need an IP rating of at least IP54 for outdoor sites.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi cần chuẩn chống bụi, nước IP tối thiểu IP54 cho các công trường ngoài trời.

vocab.d: the range of temperatures in which a device works safely
vocab.ex: Is the operating temperature suitable for an Australian summer?
vocab.exm: Nhiệt độ vận hành có phù hợp với mùa hè ở Úc không?

vocab.d: a sensor that uses laser light to measure distance and build 3D maps
vocab.ex: The LiDAR scans the site and creates a point cloud.
vocab.exm: Cảm biến LiDAR quét công trường và tạo ra đám mây điểm.

vocab.d: a set of 3D points that represents the shape of an area or object
vocab.ex: Can we export the point cloud to our own software?
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi có thể xuất đám mây điểm sang phần mềm của riêng mình không?

vocab.d: a camera that detects heat and shows temperature differences
vocab.ex: A thermal camera can find hot spots in electrical panels.
vocab.exm: Camera nhiệt có thể phát hiện các điểm nóng trong tủ điện.

vocab.d: a camera that can turn, tilt and zoom by remote control
vocab.ex: A pan-tilt-zoom camera lets us inspect details from a distance.
vocab.exm: Camera PTZ (xoay, nghiêng, zoom) cho phép chúng tôi kiểm tra chi tiết từ xa.

vocab.m: máy tính tích hợp trên máy
vocab.d: a computer built into a machine that processes its data
vocab.ex: Our software will run on the onboard computer.
vocab.exm: Phần mềm của chúng tôi sẽ chạy trên máy tính tích hợp trên máy.

vocab.m: bộ công cụ phát triển phần mềm
vocab.d: a set of tools that lets developers build software for a device
vocab.ex: Without the SDK, we cannot install our own agent software.
vocab.exm: Không có bộ công cụ phát triển phần mềm (SDK), chúng tôi không thể cài phần mềm tác tử của riêng mình.

vocab.m: giao diện lập trình ứng dụng
vocab.d: a set of rules that lets two programs exchange data
vocab.ex: We need API access to the camera and the battery status.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi cần quyền truy cập giao diện lập trình ứng dụng (API) để lấy dữ liệu camera và tình trạng pin.

vocab.m: phần mềm điều khiển thiết bị
vocab.d: the basic software built into a device that controls its hardware
vocab.ex: Will installing our software affect the firmware or the warranty?
vocab.exm: Việc cài phần mềm của chúng tôi có ảnh hưởng đến phần mềm điều khiển thiết bị hoặc bảo hành không?

vocab.m: cập nhật phần mềm từ xa (OTA)
vocab.d: a software update sent wirelessly to a device
vocab.ex: The robot receives an over-the-air update every month.
vocab.exm: Robot nhận cập nhật phần mềm từ xa (OTA) mỗi tháng.

vocab.d: moving along a route without a person controlling it
vocab.ex: Autonomous navigation on stairs needs the industrial software package.
vocab.exm: Tính năng tự hành trên cầu thang cần có gói phần mềm công nghiệp.

vocab.d: a fixed point on a route where a robot must pass or stop
vocab.ex: The robot stops at each waypoint to take photos.
vocab.exm: Robot dừng lại ở mỗi điểm mốc trên tuyến để chụp ảnh.

vocab.d: a station where a robot returns to recharge automatically
vocab.ex: The robot returns to the charging dock when the battery is low.
vocab.exm: Robot quay về trạm sạc khi pin yếu.

vocab.d: how close a measurement is to the true value
vocab.ex: LiDAR mapping accuracy is only a few centimeters.
vocab.exm: Độ chính xác của bản đồ LiDAR chỉ ở mức vài centimet.

vocab.d: the acceptable amount of error in a measurement
vocab.ex: For final acceptance, the tolerance must be within millimeters.
vocab.exm: Để nghiệm thu cuối cùng, dung sai phải nằm trong phạm vi milimet.

quiz.q: The brochure says "runtime: over 5 hours, no load". What should you ask?
o: What is the realistic runtime outdoors with a 25-kilogram payload?
Why is the battery so small?
quiz.why: Brochure figures are often measured without a load; ask about your real working conditions.

quiz.q: Which specification matters most for dust and rain on an outdoor site?
quiz.why: The IP rating shows the level of protection against dust and water.

quiz.q: Your developer needs to read camera data from the robot. What do you ask the supplier?
o: Does this model give SDK and API access to the camera feed?
quiz.why: Whether you can run custom software depends on SDK and API access.

quiz.q: "Payload" means…
o: the weight that a robot can carry
quiz.why: Payload is the maximum load a machine can carry.

quiz.q: You want to change the battery without turning the robot off.
o: Can the battery change when cold?
quiz.why: "Hot-swappable" means it can be changed while the device is on.

quiz.q: Which feature updates the software without a cable?
quiz.why: Over-the-air updates are sent wirelessly.

speak.title: Explain your technical requirements to a supplier

lines.t: The robot will patrol construction sites, both indoors and outdoors.
It needs an IP rating of at least IP54 and a runtime of two hours with a payload.
Most importantly, we need SDK access to run our own software.

speak.title: Question a figure in the specification sheet

lines.t: The specification sheet says the runtime is over five hours.
Is that measured with or without a payload?
Could you share test data for outdoor conditions?

coach.q: What will the robot be used for?
coach.vi: Robot sẽ được dùng vào việc gì?
coach.st: It will be used to + tasks + at/in + place.
coach.sa: It will be used to patrol construction sites in Australia, capture daily photos at fixed waypoints and build 3D maps to track progress.
coach.sc: A supplier's engineer asks about your use case before recommending a model.

coach.q: Which technical features are essential for you?
coach.vi: Tính năng kỹ thuật nào là bắt buộc với bạn?
coach.st: The essential features are + list.
coach.sa: The essential features are an outdoor IP rating, automatic recharging at a charging dock and full SDK access for our own software.
coach.sc: The supplier asks you to rank your requirements.

coach.q: Is centimeter-level accuracy enough for your project?
coach.vi: Độ chính xác cỡ centimet có đủ cho dự án không?
coach.st: It is enough for + purpose, but not for + purpose.
coach.sa: It is enough for tracking progress, but not for final acceptance, where we would need millimeter tolerance from survey equipment.
coach.sc: A site engineer questions whether the robot's measurements are reliable.

coach.q: What happens if installing your software voids the warranty?
coach.vi: Nếu cài phần mềm riêng làm mất bảo hành thì sao?
coach.st: In that case, we would need to + actions.
coach.sa: In that case, we would need written confirmation of what is still covered, try to negotiate the terms, or choose a model that allows custom software.
coach.sc: The distributor warns that custom software may affect the warranty.

fill.text:
Subject: Technical questions – A2 Pro

Dear Le Hoang team,

We have reviewed the specification [[sheet|paper|list]] for the A2 Pro and have a few technical questions.

1. What is the realistic runtime [[with|by|for]] a 25 kg payload?
2. Is the IP rating valid for the whole robot or only for the [[core|heart|middle]] components?
3. Does the SDK give access [[to|for|with]] the LiDAR and camera data?

We would appreciate a written reply, as your answers will [[determine|decide on|depend]] which model we choose.

Best regards,
Sally

topics.title: Acceptance testing, warranty and after-sales service

vocab.d: a test to check that equipment works as agreed before the buyer accepts it
vocab.ex: We will run an acceptance test on site before we sign.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi sẽ chạy thử nghiệm thu tại chỗ trước khi ký.

vocab.d: a document listing the goods delivered, signed by the receiver
vocab.ex: Please sign the delivery note and note any damage.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng ký phiếu giao hàng và ghi chú mọi hư hỏng.

vocab.d: opening the packaging of a new product
vocab.ex: Record a video during unboxing in case there is damage.
vocab.exm: Hãy quay video khi mở thùng phòng trường hợp có hư hỏng.

vocab.d: damage that can be seen from the outside
vocab.ex: Note any visible damage before you sign.
vocab.exm: Hãy ghi chú mọi hư hỏng nhìn thấy được trước khi ký.

vocab.d: a test to check that each function works
vocab.ex: The functional test covers walking, charging and the cameras.
vocab.exm: Phần thử chức năng bao gồm di chuyển, sạc pin và các camera.

vocab.d: the conditions a product must meet to be accepted
vocab.ex: The acceptance criteria were agreed in the purchase agreement.
vocab.exm: Tiêu chí nghiệm thu đã được thống nhất trong hợp đồng mua bán.

vocab.d: a failure of a machine to work properly
vocab.ex: If there is a malfunction during testing, we will request a replacement.
vocab.exm: Nếu có trục trặc trong quá trình thử nghiệm, chúng tôi sẽ yêu cầu đổi máy.

vocab.d: replacing a faulty unit with a new identical unit
vocab.ex: The distributor offers a one-to-one replacement within the test period.
vocab.exm: Nhà phân phối cung cấp chính sách đổi 1-1 trong thời gian thử nghiệm.

vocab.d: the time during which repairs are free under the warranty
vocab.ex: The warranty period starts on the delivery date.
vocab.exm: Thời hạn bảo hành bắt đầu tính từ ngày giao hàng.

vocab.d: a warranty that is valid in more than one country
vocab.ex: Is this an international warranty or only valid in Vietnam?
vocab.exm: Đây là bảo hành quốc tế hay chỉ có hiệu lực tại Việt Nam?

vocab.m: làm mất hiệu lực bảo hành
vocab.d: make the warranty no longer valid
vocab.ex: Opening the battery case may void the warranty.
vocab.exm: Mở vỏ pin có thể làm mất hiệu lực bảo hành.

vocab.d: a place where products are repaired
vocab.ex: Where is the nearest authorized service center in Australia?
vocab.exm: Trung tâm bảo hành chính hãng gần nhất ở Úc nằm ở đâu?

vocab.d: extra parts kept to replace broken ones
vocab.ex: We should keep spare parts such as feet and a second battery.
vocab.exm: Chúng ta nên giữ sẵn phụ tùng thay thế như chân robot và một viên pin thứ hai.

vocab.d: finding and fixing the cause of a problem
vocab.ex: The manual has a troubleshooting section.
vocab.exm: Sách hướng dẫn có một phần về xử lý sự cố.

vocab.d: help from a technician through the internet or by phone
vocab.ex: Most software issues can be solved with remote support.
vocab.exm: Hầu hết các sự cố phần mềm có thể được giải quyết bằng hỗ trợ từ xa.

vocab.d: training that helps new users start using a product
vocab.ex: The distributor provides onboarding training for two operators.
vocab.exm: Nhà phân phối cung cấp đào tạo ban đầu cho hai người vận hành.

vocab.d: a document that explains how to use a product
vocab.ex: Is the user manual available in English?
vocab.exm: Sách hướng dẫn sử dụng có bản tiếng Anh không?

vocab.d: give formal approval that work is complete
vocab.ex: The site manager will sign off after the test.
vocab.exm: Quản lý công trường sẽ ký duyệt sau khi thử nghiệm.

vocab.m: vận hành thử, đưa vào sử dụng
vocab.d: preparing and testing new equipment so it is ready for normal use
vocab.ex: Commissioning on site will take two days.
vocab.exm: Việc vận hành thử tại công trường sẽ mất hai ngày.

vocab.d: the standard of service a provider promises, such as response time
vocab.ex: What service level do you offer for urgent repairs?
vocab.exm: Anh/chị cung cấp mức dịch vụ nào cho các trường hợp sửa chữa khẩn cấp?

quiz.q: You notice a scratch on the robot when it arrives. What do you do first?
o: Note the visible damage on the delivery note and take photos before signing
quiz.why: Record damage at delivery; claims are harder once you have signed a clean delivery note.

quiz.q: The robot fails the charging test on day two. Which request fits the agreed terms?
o: We would like to request a one-to-one replacement, as agreed for the test period.
Give us our money back now.
quiz.why: Refer to the agreed term and ask for the specific remedy.

quiz.q: "Void the warranty" means…
o: make the warranty no longer valid
quiz.why: Void = cancel; unauthorized changes often void a warranty.

quiz.q: "Acceptance criteria" are…
o: the conditions the product must meet to be accepted
quiz.why: Acceptance criteria are agreed before the test.

quiz.q: The robot stops working in the first week.
o: The unit stopped working after two days. Could you advise on troubleshooting or send a replacement?
Your robot is bad, fix it now.
The robot is sleeping, please help.
quiz.why: Describe the problem with facts and ask for a clear next step.

quiz.q: You need your team to learn how to use the robot.
o: Could you provide onboarding training for our operators?
Please teach all of us the robot.
We want learn the robot quickly.
quiz.why: "Onboarding training" helps new users start working with a product.

speak.title: Report a problem during acceptance testing

lines.t: During the acceptance test, the robot did not return to the charging dock.
We repeated the test three times with the same result.
Could you arrange remote support or a one-to-one replacement?

speak.title: Ask about after-sales service in Australia

lines.t: We will use the robot on sites in Australia.
Is the warranty valid there, and where is the nearest service center?
How quickly can you supply spare parts?

coach.q: What will you check when the robot arrives?
coach.vi: Bạn sẽ kiểm tra gì khi robot về?
coach.st: First we + action, then we + action.
coach.sa: First we record the unboxing and check for visible damage, then we run a functional test of walking, charging and the cameras.
coach.sc: The distributor asks how you will handle delivery day.

coach.q: What are your acceptance criteria?
coach.vi: Tiêu chí nghiệm thu của bạn là gì?
coach.st: The robot must + requirements.
coach.sa: The robot must complete a full patrol route, return to the dock automatically and send images to our software without errors.
coach.sc: The distributor wants to agree on acceptance criteria before delivery.

coach.q: What support do you expect after the purchase?
coach.vi: Bạn mong đợi hỗ trợ gì sau khi mua?
coach.st: We expect + support.
coach.sa: We expect onboarding training for our operators, remote support for software issues and fast delivery of spare parts.
coach.sc: The distributor asks what after-sales package you need.

coach.q: What will you do if the warranty is not valid in Australia?
coach.vi: Bạn sẽ làm gì nếu bảo hành không có hiệu lực ở Úc?
coach.st: We would + action + or + action.
coach.sa: We would negotiate an extended warranty with the distributor or use a local service partner, and budget for repairs.
coach.sc: The founder asks about the risk of repairs abroad.

fill.text:
Subject: Acceptance test result – charging issue

Dear Support team,

We received the robot on Monday and started the acceptance test [[on|in|at]] site. Most functions passed, but the robot [[failed|fail|failing]] to return to the charging dock in all three tests.

As agreed, a malfunction during the test period [[qualifies|qualify|qualifying]] for a one-to-one replacement. Please let us know the next steps.

We have attached the test log and a video [[of|for|from]] the issue.

topics.title: Shipping to Australia: couriers, air cargo and biosecurity

vocab.d: a company that delivers parcels quickly door to door, often handling customs
vocab.ex: An express courier is faster for one unit, but it costs more.
vocab.exm: Chuyển phát nhanh nhanh hơn cho một chiếc, nhưng chi phí cao hơn.

vocab.d: goods sent by plane as freight, not as a passenger's luggage
vocab.ex: Air cargo takes a few days, including customs clearance.
vocab.exm: Hàng hoá đường hàng không mất vài ngày, bao gồm cả thông quan.

vocab.d: covering transport from the sender's address to the receiver's address
vocab.ex: We prefer a door-to-door service to the site office.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi muốn dịch vụ giao tận nơi đến văn phòng công trường.

vocab.ex: The chargeable weight is based on the box size, not the robot's weight.
vocab.exm: Trọng lượng tính cước dựa trên kích thước thùng, không phải trọng lượng của robot.

vocab.d: a weight calculated from the size of a package
vocab.ex: Large, light boxes are charged by volumetric weight.
vocab.exm: Những thùng lớn nhưng nhẹ được tính cước theo trọng lượng thể tích.

vocab.m: kiểm dịch, an toàn sinh học
vocab.d: rules that protect a country from pests and diseases brought in by goods
vocab.ex: Australia has strict biosecurity rules for wooden packaging.
vocab.exm: Úc có quy định kiểm dịch nghiêm ngặt đối với bao bì gỗ.

vocab.m: tiêu chuẩn xử lý bao bì gỗ ISPM 15
vocab.d: the international standard for treating wooden packaging such as pallets
vocab.ex: All wooden pallets must be treated and stamped under ISPM 15.
vocab.exm: Tất cả pallet gỗ phải được xử lý và đóng dấu theo tiêu chuẩn xử lý bao bì gỗ ISPM 15.

vocab.d: treating goods or packaging with gas to kill insects
vocab.ex: The crate needs fumigation before shipment.
vocab.exm: Thùng gỗ cần được hun trùng trước khi vận chuyển.

vocab.d: treating wood with heat to kill pests
vocab.ex: Heat treatment is an approved method under ISPM 15.
vocab.exm: Xử lý nhiệt là một phương pháp được chấp thuận theo ISPM 15.

vocab.d: Australia's tax on goods and services, similar to VAT
vocab.ex: Import GST is calculated on the customs value plus freight and insurance.
vocab.exm: Thuế GST của Úc khi nhập khẩu được tính trên trị giá hải quan cộng cước vận chuyển và bảo hiểm.

vocab.d: the value of goods used to calculate duty and tax
vocab.ex: The customs value must match the commercial invoice.
vocab.exm: Trị giá hải quan phải khớp với hoá đơn thương mại.

vocab.d: the person or company that receives the goods
vocab.ex: Please put our Sydney office as the consignee.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng ghi văn phòng Sydney của chúng tôi là người nhận hàng.

vocab.d: the person or company that sends the goods
vocab.ex: The shipper must sign the dangerous goods declaration.
vocab.exm: Người gửi hàng phải ký tờ khai hàng nguy hiểm.

vocab.d: bringing goods into a country for a limited time without paying full duty
vocab.ex: We asked the broker whether a temporary import is possible for testing.
vocab.exm: Chúng tôi đã hỏi đại lý hải quan xem có thể tạm nhập để thử nghiệm không.

vocab.d: a document or signature showing that the goods were delivered
vocab.ex: Please send the proof of delivery once the parcel arrives.
vocab.exm: Vui lòng gửi bằng chứng giao hàng khi kiện hàng đến nơi.

vocab.d: insurance that covers goods while they are being transported
vocab.ex: High-value equipment should have transit insurance.
vocab.exm: Thiết bị giá trị cao nên có bảo hiểm vận chuyển.

vocab.d: kept by customs until a problem is solved
vocab.ex: The parcel was held at customs because a document was missing.
vocab.exm: Kiện hàng bị hải quan giữ vì thiếu một chứng từ.

vocab.d: allow goods to leave customs after clearance
vocab.ex: Customs released the shipment this morning.
vocab.exm: Hải quan đã giải phóng lô hàng vào sáng nay.

vocab.d: the last stage of delivery to the final address
vocab.ex: The final mile to the site will be by local truck.
vocab.exm: Chặng giao cuối đến công trường sẽ đi bằng xe tải địa phương.

vocab.d: comparing prices from several transport providers
vocab.ex: Let's do a rate comparison between three couriers.
vocab.exm: Chúng ta hãy so sánh giá cước giữa ba đơn vị chuyển phát.

quiz.q: You ship one robot in a large, light box. How is the price likely to be calculated?
o: By chargeable weight, which may be the volumetric weight
quiz.why: Carriers charge the higher of the actual and the volumetric weight.

quiz.q: Your crate sits on a wooden pallet. What must you check for Australia?
o: That the pallet is treated and stamped under ISPM 15
quiz.why: Under biosecurity rules, untreated wood can be refused or treated at your cost.

quiz.q: Customs is holding your parcel. What is the best first message?
o: Could you tell us which document or information customs needs to release the parcel?
quiz.why: Find out exactly what is missing so that customs can release it.

quiz.q: Which term describes the delivery from the local hub to the customer's door?
quiz.why: The final mile is the last step of delivery.

quiz.q: What is GST?
o: a tax on goods and services in Australia
quiz.why: GST stands for goods and services tax.

quiz.q: You want to know how long the parcel will take.
o: What is the estimated transit time door-to-door?
Is the parcel late or not?
quiz.why: Use "estimated transit time" and name the service you mean.

speak.title: Compare courier and air cargo with your manager

lines.t: For one robot, an express courier is faster and handles customs for us.
Air cargo may be cheaper, but we need a broker at both ends.
Both options need dangerous goods approval for the battery.

speak.title: Call about a parcel held at customs

lines.t: Our parcel has been held at customs in Sydney since Tuesday.
Could you tell us what information is missing?
We can send the commercial invoice and the battery documents today.

coach.q: How will you send the robot to Australia?
coach.vi: Bạn sẽ gửi robot sang Úc bằng cách nào?
coach.st: We are considering + options; the final choice depends on + factors.
coach.sa: We are considering an express courier or air cargo; the final choice depends on the battery rules, the total cost and how soon the site needs it.
coach.sc: The Australian site manager asks when and how the robot will arrive.

coach.q: What could delay the shipment at Australian customs?
coach.vi: Điều gì có thể làm lô hàng chậm ở hải quan Úc?
coach.st: It could be delayed by + problems.
coach.sa: It could be delayed by missing documents, untreated wooden packaging or a mismatch between the customs value and the invoice.
coach.sc: Your director wants to know the main shipping risks.

coach.q: Who should be the consignee?
coach.vi: Ai nên đứng tên người nhận hàng?
coach.st: The consignee should be + party, because + reason.
coach.sa: The consignee should be our Australian office, because they will receive the goods and act as the importer of record.
coach.sc: The courier asks who will receive the parcel in Australia.

vocab.m: giai đoạn tăng tốc sản xuất

vocab.d: an inspection of a factory's systems, quality and conditions

vocab.d: change a product's name, logo or design to a new brand

quiz.q: You want the factory's existing robot with your logo and software. Which model is this?

o: Could you quote tiered pricing for 10, 50 and 100 units?
quiz.why: Tiered pricing shows how the unit price changes with volume and reveals the MOQ.

quiz.q: "Golden sample" means…
o: the approved sample that mass production must match

quiz.q: You want to reduce the cost of tooling.
o: Could the tooling cost be shared, or refunded after a certain volume?
Tooling is too expensive, change it.

quiz.q: You want to keep your design after the project ends.
o: Does the contract state that the intellectual property belongs to us?
Is the design mine, I think?
The design is just ideas, no problem.

topics.title: Running the operation: owners, approvals and closing a shipment

vocab.d: a table showing who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed for each task

vocab.d: having to take final responsibility for a result

vocab.m: họp rút kinh nghiệm sau lô hàng

quiz.q: Who is "accountable" in a RACI chart?
o: The one person who takes final responsibility for the result
The person who only gives advice
quiz.why: There should be exactly one accountable person for each task.

quiz.q: QC reports a fail, but the vessel leaves tomorrow. What does the checkpoint rule say?
o: Do not ship; escalate to the founder and agree on a new plan.
Ship anyway to keep the booking.
quiz.why: A checkpoint is a rule, not advice: no pass, no shipment.

quiz.q: What is the purpose of a post-shipment review?
o: To compare actual results with the plan and fix recurring issues
quiz.why: Reviews turn problems into updated SOPs and checklists.

quiz.q: A task has no clear owner. What do you do?
o: Assign one owner and a deadline in the tracker.
Ask everyone to do it together.
quiz.why: Every task needs one owner and a date.

quiz.q: "Hand off" means…
o: pass a task to another person
quiz.why: A hand-off passes responsibility to someone else.

quiz.q: What is a decision log for?
o: to record what was decided and by whom
quiz.why: A decision log avoids repeated discussions and unclear decisions.
